start.speaker: dax
start.text: Vault rule: you do not talk about the seal in front of the people it is keeping alive. So. Here. If it goes, my family goes, and I will not be much use to you after. I am telling you so you can plan for it. That is all this is.

choices.text: We plan for it by not letting it go. The seal is on the list.
You would still be use to us. You are not only the seal.
Understood. Thank you for telling me.

list.speaker: dax
list.text: Then put it high. Good night.

more.speaker: dax
more.text: That is a magic-user thing to say. I will let it go this once. Good night.
